1.title: Ganesha mantra practice
1.method: After a morning bath, light a lamp before Ganesha and chant the mantra.

2.title: Mahalakshmi mantra
2.method: On Friday, light a lamp in a clean place and chant the Lakshmi mantra.
2.caution: Do not treat this as a guarantee of income.

3.title: Friday ghee lamp
3.problem: Want a positive feeling about money at home
3.method: On Friday evening, light a ghee lamp at the place of worship.
3.caution: Keep the lamp in a safe spot.

4.title: Shri Suktam recitation
4.method: On Friday, recite the Shri Suktam or listen to it with faith.
4.caution: Keep the pronunciation correct if you can.

5.title: Remembering Lakshmi’s name
5.method: Sit quietly, remember Lakshmi, and chant the mantra.
5.caution: Treat it as a mental and spiritual practice.

6.title: Friday cleaning practice
6.problem: Clutter at home and money worry
6.method: On Friday, clean the home, especially the shrine and entrance.
6.caution: Do not treat this as a guarantee of success.
6.basis: Traditional link between cleanliness and Lakshmi

7.title: Remembering Kubera
7.method: Light a lamp at the shrine and remember Kubera.
7.caution: Do not use the mantra for greed or dishonest gain.

8.title: Offering food
8.problem: A positive practice during money trouble
8.method: Give food or grain to someone in need, within your means.
8.caution: Give only what you can afford.

9.title: Offering water and a prayer
9.method: At sunrise, offer water to the sun and pray for success in your work.
9.caution: Do not stare at the sun.

10.title: Budget resolve
10.method: Each morning, write the day’s spending and resolve to skip needless expenses.
10.caution: Keep a real financial plan along with the practice.

11.title: Ganesha prayer for debt relief
11.method: Light a lamp before Ganesha and pray for freedom from debt and for sound decisions.

12.title: Hanuman Chalisa recitation
12.method: On Tuesday or Saturday, recite the Hanuman Chalisa.
12.caution: Do not treat this as a promise that the debt will vanish.

13.title: Debt-payment resolve
13.method: Write down the full debt and resolve to pay a fixed amount each month.
13.caution: Base the plan on real income.

14.title: Tuesday Hanuman worship
14.method: On Tuesday, light a lamp before Hanuman and pray.
14.caution: Keep oil and the lamp fire-safe.

15.title: Saturday service
15.problem: A positive practice in a hard time
15.method: On Saturday, serve someone in need, within your means.

16.title: Ganesha mantra at the start of business
16.method: Chant the Ganesha mantra before opening the shop or office.
16.caution: Do not make business decisions on the remedy alone.

17.title: Lamp at the workplace
17.problem: Want a positive mood in the business
17.method: Light a lamp in a safe place at work and pray.

18.title: Remembering Lakshmi and Kubera
18.problem: Wish for money to flow in business
18.method: On Friday evening, remember Lakshmi and Kubera.
18.caution: Do not use this to justify unethical trade.

19.title: Workplace cleanliness
19.method: Each day, keep the entrance, counter, and workspace clean.
19.caution: Do not treat this as a guaranteed Vastu cure.

20.title: Business diary resolve
20.method: Each night, write sales, expenses, dues, and three important tasks for tomorrow.
20.caution: Keep records based on real figures.

21.title: Prayer to the sun
21.method: At sunrise, offer water to the sun and pray for clear judgment in business.
21.caution: Do not look at the sun for long.

22.title: Mercury mantra
22.method: On Wednesday, remember Mercury for calculation, speech, and judgment.
22.caution: Do not replace expert business advice with an astrological remedy.

23.title: Thursday remembrance of the guru
23.method: On Thursday, remember the guru principle and pray for right decisions.
23.caution: Decide money matters from facts and advice.

24.title: Resolve to respect customers
24.method: Each day, respectfully ask at least three customers for feedback.

25.title: Dues discipline
25.method: Each morning, review the dues list and follow up politely.

26.title: Evening lamp
26.method: In the evening, light a lamp at the home shrine and pray for family peace.

27.title: Family Ganesha prayer
27.method: Family members together offer a short prayer to Ganesha.
27.caution: Do not force the practice on anyone.

28.title: Peace mantra
28.method: Family members sit quietly and chant the peace mantra.
28.caution: For a serious family problem, also talk or seek counsel.

29.title: Weekly shared meal
29.method: Once a week, eat together without phones.
29.caution: Do not raise disputed topics at the meal.

30.title: Keep the entrance clean
30.method: Keep the main door and the area around it clean.
30.caution: Do not treat this as a certain change of fortune.

31.title: Peace prayer for a couple
31.method: Pray together quietly and each say one good thing about the other.
31.caution: In violence or a serious dispute, safety and professional help come first.

32.title: Hanuman Chalisa for the family
32.method: If the family wishes, read the Hanuman Chalisa together on Tuesday.
32.caution: Do not treat this as medical care for a mental or domestic problem.

33.title: Lamp near the tulsi plant
33.problem: Want a positive mood at home
33.method: In the evening, light a lamp safely near the tulsi plant.
33.caution: Keep the lamp away from the plant and anything flammable.

34.title: A day for apology and talk
34.method: Set aside one day a week for the family to settle old disputes calmly.
34.caution: Do not face humiliation or violence alone.

35.title: Positive speech at home
35.method: For 21 days, resolve together to avoid abuse, insults, and shouting.
35.caution: In a violent situation, safety comes first.

36.title: Sun mantra
36.method: In the morning, offer water to the sun.
36.caution: Do not stare at the sun.

37.title: Ganesha prayer before an interview
37.method: Before the interview, sit quietly and chant the Ganesha mantra.

38.title: Mercury mantra
38.method: On Wednesday, chant the Mercury mantra.
38.caution: Take it as an astrological belief.

39.title: Jupiter mantra
39.method: On Thursday, chant the Jupiter mantra.
39.caution: Make career decisions from real circumstances.

40.title: 21-day skill practice
40.method: Each day, spend at least 30 minutes learning a skill tied to your work.

41.title: Sun remedy
41.method: At sunrise, offer water to the sun.
41.caution: Do not look directly at the sun.

42.title: Moon remedy
42.method: On Monday, remember the moon deity with a quiet mind.
42.caution: For serious mental distress, seek a specialist.

44.title: Mercury remedy
44.caution: Do not treat this as a guarantee of business success.

45.title: Jupiter remedy
45.method: On Thursday, chant the Brihaspati mantra.
45.caution: Without a personal chart, treat this as a general remedy.

46.title: Venus remedy
46.method: On Friday, chant the Lakshmi mantra.

47.title: Saturn remedy
47.method: On Saturday, serve, give within your means, and chant the Saturn mantra.
47.caution: Do not buy costly remedies out of fear.

48.title: Rahu remedy
48.method: On Saturday, sit quietly and chant the Rahu mantra.

49.title: Ketu remedy
49.method: On Tuesday, sit in quiet meditation and chant the Ketu mantra.
49.caution: Do not treat this as a certain cure for a planetary affliction.

50.title: Prayer to the nine planets
50.method: Each day, pray for respect and peace toward all planets.
50.caution: A special planetary affliction is a separate matter that needs a personal chart.

51.title: Ganesha incense prayer
51.problem: A block at the start of work

52.title: Remembering Hanuman’s name
52.method: With a quiet mind, chant Hanuman’s name.
52.caution: For serious fear or anxiety, seek professional help.

53.title: Morning prayer
53.method: In the morning, sit quietly for three minutes and set a positive resolve for the day.
53.caution: If negative thoughts persist, talk to a specialist.

54.title: Lamp and peace mantra at home
54.method: In the evening, light a lamp and say the peace mantra.

55.title: Sundarkand recitation
55.problem: Spiritual support in a hard time
55.method: Recite or listen to the Sundarkand as you are able.
55.caution: Take the recitation as a mental and spiritual practice.

56.title: Gayatri mantra
56.method: Chant the Gayatri mantra in a quiet place.
56.caution: It is better to learn the pronunciation.

57.title: Om chant
57.method: Sit comfortably and chant Om slowly.

58.title: Charity practice
58.problem: Wish to move out of negativity
58.method: Each week, help someone in need within your means.
58.caution: Do not borrow in order to give.

59.title: Service practice
59.method: At least once a week, help a person or a living being without expecting return.

60.title: 21-day drop of a harmful habit
60.method: Pick one harmful habit and record reducing it for 21 days.
60.caution: For a serious addiction, seek a specialist.

61.title: Friday flower remembrance
61.method: On Friday, offer a clean flower you already have to Lakshmi.
61.caution: You do not need an expensive flower.

62.title: Respect for food
62.method: For 21 days, resolve to stop wasting food.

63.title: Charity box
63.method: Set aside a small amount each day and give it to someone in need during the month.
63.caution: First cover necessary expenses and debt payments.

64.title: Fast from needless spending
64.method: One day each week, spend only on what is necessary.
64.caution: Do not cut needed medicine or food.

65.title: Lakshmi aarti
65.method: On Friday evening, perform Lakshmi’s aarti.
65.caution: Do not treat the aarti as a guarantee of gain.

66.title: Prayer before opening the shop
66.problem: A block at the start of business
66.method: While opening the shop, say the Ganesha mantra 11 times.

67.title: Honouring the account book
67.method: Light a lamp before the account book or computer and resolve to trade honestly.

68.title: Gratitude for the first sale
68.method: After the first sale, silently thank the customer and the divine.
68.caution: Do not impose a religious practice on a customer.

69.title: Thursday learning practice
69.method: Every Thursday, learn one new thing about the business.

70.title: Respect for the customer
70.method: Each day, speak respectfully with at least five customers.

71.title: Saraswati prayer
71.problem: A block in study and skill

72.title: Five minutes of attention before an interview
72.method: Before the interview, take five minutes of slow breath and a positive resolve.
72.caution: If you feel dizzy, breathe normally.

73.title: Wednesday skill day
73.method: Every Wednesday, work on one skill of your profession.
73.caution: Do not rely on the mantra alone.
73.basis: Mercury worship plus practical skill building

74.title: Morning goal writing
74.problem: Lack of direction in a career
74.method: In the morning, write the three most important career tasks for the day.
74.caution: Do not set too many goals.

75.title: Honouring the teacher
75.method: Express respect and thanks to your teacher or mentor.
75.caution: Do not treat a person as a guru out of blind belief.

77.title: Cash discipline
77.method: Each evening, match cash and bank balance records.

78.title: Weekly spending review
78.method: Every Sunday, review all of last week’s expenses.
78.caution: Do not wrongly cut necessary spending.

79.title: Truthful speech in business
79.method: For 21 days, resolve to give only correct information about the product, price, and delivery.

80.title: Save a percent of earnings
80.method: From every income, set aside a fixed percent you can afford.
80.caution: If high-interest debt exists, set priority carefully.

81.title: 21 days of morning bath and prayer
81.method: In the morning, wash and pray for five minutes.
81.caution: Fit the routine to your health.

82.title: Ten minutes of silence
82.method: Each day, sit quietly for 10 minutes without a phone.
82.caution: Shorten the time if you feel uneasy.

83.title: Gratitude writing
83.method: At night, write three things you are grateful for.
83.caution: For a serious mental problem, seek a specialist.

84.title: Mantra chant with a mala
84.method: Chant a simple mantra of your tradition 108 times.

85.title: Shiva five-syllable mantra
85.method: Chant the Shiva mantra in a quiet place.
85.caution: Do not treat this as treatment for an illness.

86.title: Monday Shiva prayer
86.method: On Monday, offer clean water on the Shiva linga.

87.title: Mahamrityunjaya mantra
87.method: Chant or listen to the Mahamrityunjaya mantra with faith.
87.caution: This is not a substitute for medical treatment.

88.title: Tuesday vermilion offering
88.method: Worship Hanuman according to the temple’s tradition.
88.caution: Follow the temple’s permission and custom.

89.title: Saturday Hanuman Chalisa
89.problem: Mental strength in a hard time
89.method: On Saturday, read the Hanuman Chalisa.
89.caution: Do not make a religious practice a tool of fear.

90.title: Food for someone in need
90.method: Give food to a person in need, within your means.
90.caution: Respect the person’s dignity while giving.

91.title: Grain for birds
91.method: Place suitable grain for birds in a clean, safe place.
91.basis: Indian tradition of kindness to living beings

92.title: Water service
92.method: In hot weather, keep clean water in a safe place for birds and animals.

93.title: Morning 108 chants and three goals
93.method: After 108 chants, write the day’s three main goals.

94.title: 21 days of rising earlier
94.method: Build a waking time you can keep.

95.title: Night review of spending
95.problem: You do not know where the money goes
95.method: Each night, write the whole day’s expenses.

96.title: Lakshmi mantra, 108 chants
96.method: On Friday, sit in a clean place and chant the Lakshmi mantra.
96.caution: There is no guarantee of financial gain.

97.title: Ganesha–Lakshmi business prayer
97.method: On the first day or a new start, remember Ganesha and Lakshmi.
97.caution: Also make a business plan and study the market.

98.title: Peace recitation at home
98.method: Willing family members sit together and chant the peace mantra.
98.caution: In violence or a serious dispute, get real help.

99.title: One list of debts and expenses
99.method: Write every loan, EMI, interest, income, and necessary expense in one place.
99.caution: Before a large debt decision, take qualified financial advice.

100.title: 21-day Ganesha–Lakshmi discipline
100.problem: Blocks in money, business, and life
100.method: In the morning chant the Ganesha mantra 108 times, in the evening the Lakshmi mantra 108 times, and each day write three necessary tasks and the expenses.
100.caution: Do not treat this as a miracle or a guarantee of money.
